title: Meet the retailer energy productivity target
what: As an electricity (or gas) retailer above the thresholds, achieve the annual energy productivity target set for retailers by carrying out or acquiring energy productivity activities, and report them to the Commission (the Retailer Energy Productivity Scheme).

sources.title: Electricity (General) Regulations 2012 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The Minister must, by notice in the Gazette, set the annual energy productivity targets for the purposes of this Part, being the amount of normalised gigajoules required to be achieved by retailers through the carrying out of energy productivity activities

marks.reason: Retailers must fund and record energy savings activities each period.
The obligation adds a fixed compliance cost that weighs more on smaller retailers, who may pay a contribution instead.
